rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded day-5 blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately cautious about image-only limits, though not especially granular beyond the supplied grade.

Strong integration of age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately tempered by maternal age and possible hydrosalpinx; minor issue is some reliance on assumptions not provided in the case.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and common ASRM/ESHRE practice, including SET preference and hydrosalpinx attention; slight overreach in discussing PGT-A benefits without more nuance.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx confirmation, luteal support review, lifestyle changes, and future evaluation if unsuccessful.
